spec.caption:
October 20, 2026 snapshot: top 5 eligible countries in the remote Web3 catalog. Most roles were country-restricted.

Multi-country listings count once per named country.

1. United States: 155 fully remote listings across 30 employers, the largest explicit-country count in the Oct 20 catalog.

Eligibility follows the role's stated location, not employer headquarters.

2. United Kingdom: 29 listings across 4 employers in the Oct 20 catalog. The US had 126 more listings and 26 more employers.

Counts follow explicitly eligible locations, not company headquarters.

3. Cyprus: 11 listings across 2 employers in the Oct 20 catalog.

Cyprus, Georgia and Poland tie on listing count, but their employer counts differ: 2, 1 and 4 respectively.

4. Georgia: 11 listings, all from 1 employer in the Oct 20 catalog. Poland had the same listing count across 4 employers.

Equal listing volume can hide different employer concentration.

5. Poland: 11 listings across 4 employers in the Oct 20, 2026 catalog.

Ranking excludes 6 worldwide and 180 unresolved-location listings. Multi-country listings count in each named country, so totals overlap.

Full resource: hashtagweb3.com/jobs/ig
